svg.title: Contributor level 100: Golden jacket, beanie, headphones and lanyard
svg.desc: FrogPilot (driver-assistance software for cars) Contributor badge, level 100: the master frog in a polished gold beanie with a purple stripe and a gold pompom, gold headphones round the neck, thick round gold glasses, a gold lanyard and ID card and a polished gold jacket with purple stripes down the sleeves, purple trim and purple patches with gold marks.
